name: buddy
description: A tiny ASCII pet that lives above your prompt, reacts to everything Claude does, and levels up as you ship.

name.title: Pet name
name.description: What your pet is called. /buddy name <name> changes it too.

species.title: Species
species.description: Which pet you get. /buddy species <kind> changes it too.

sleepAfterSeconds.title: Naps after (seconds)
sleepAfterSeconds.description: How long without activity before your pet dozes off.
